reason: I'd probably try the free 14 days since there's no auto-charge, but I'm a student with almost no income and YouTube sleep music already does the job, so paying 4,900 won every month for a fade-out timer isn't happening. I've tried a bunch of sleep apps and none really fixed it.
objection: It's still just sleep sounds that fade out. A few minutes' difference on a chart isn't worth a monthly fee when I'm counting every won and free stuff exists.
would_change_my_mind: If the 14-day comparison showed I fell asleep a lot faster, like 15+ minutes, and there was a cheap student price around 2,000 won a month or a one-time purchase.
